spanish: Si siendo hallado es hallado en su mano el hurto, desde buey hasta asno hasta cordero, vivos, dos pagará.

findings.issue: שֶׂה (H7716), a single common-gender flock animal (sheep or goat), is narrowed to a young sheep.

notes: The other tokens match: inf. abs. + niphal 3fs, in his hand, the theft, from ox until donkey until flock-animal, living (mp), two, piel 3ms repay.
